limitations: Suitability scores and profile limits are documented prototype heuristics, not medical advice or a safety guarantee.
Air quality is a regional forecast using US AQI, not a street-level measurement.
Traffic uses mapped roads and commute-hour proxies; route times do not include live congestion.
Mapped water and greenery influence preferences and cautions; shade, barriers and local flooding are not verified. Small map extracts can omit unmapped features or enclosing polygons.
At most five compatible venues are compared. Commutes sample weather/context near a verified route midpoint, not every metre.
Opening hours, access, surface condition and booking must be checked with the venue.
